title: 1B04ExtraNPCs - Character Bios
tagline: Hand-written SkyrimNet bios for 30 NPCs from 1B04ExtraNPCs.
description:
Official SkyrimNet character bios for NPCs added by 1B04ExtraNPCs (1B04ExtraNPCs.esp).

Install this if 1B04ExtraNPCs.esp is in your load order. NPCs without a static bio still get one generated automatically from their game data; this pack replaces that with the community-curated version.

Bios are the work of the SkyrimNet community.
author: skyrimnet
